modified_at.description: The time at which this table was last modified.

created_at.description: The time at which this resource was created.

allOf.description: *Create-only*. The workspace or organization this table is associated with. Once created, tables cannot be moved to a different workspace. This attribute can only be specified at creation time.

custom_field_settings.description: Array of custom field definitions that are enabled for the table. These represent which custom fields are available to records in the table, but do not include any values.

default_access_level.description: The default access level for users who join or are added as members of the table.
